library.pt_160:r_824382c70a5ab386.text:
An executive of the lunar conglomerate Anaheim Electronics. Age 33.
His father is $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, head of the Vist Foundation, making him $$バナージ$$'s older half-brother.
He is weak-willed and prone to petty scheming, and harbors a complex toward the father who never paid him any attention. $$マーサ$$ has exploited that weakness in his heart and uses him as her lapdog.
On $$マーサ$$'s orders, wanting to prevent the disclosure of 'Laplace's Box', he boards the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.
He infiltrates Industrial 7 together with the Ecoes, and though he manages to restrain $$カーディアス$$ once, he ends up shooting him in the heat of the moment.

library.pt_160:r_207c96af70c1a680.text:
An executive of the lunar conglomerate Anaheim Electronics. Age 33.
His father is $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, head of the Vist Foundation, making him $$バナージ$$'s older half-brother.
He is weak-willed and prone to petty scheming, and harbors a complex toward the father who never paid him any attention. $$マーサ$$ has exploited that weakness in his heart and uses him as her lapdog.
On $$マーサ$$'s orders, wanting to prevent the disclosure of 'Laplace's Box', he boards the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.
He infiltrates Industrial 7 together with the Ecoes, and though he manages to restrain $$カーディアス$$ once, he ends up shooting him in the heat of the moment.
He continues to remain aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ afterward, trying to take control of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$. At the same time, he comes to view $$バナージ$$, to whom his father $$カーディアス$$ entrusted the Unicorn, as an enemy.

library.pt_160:r_51dbe6b306f475c0.text:
$$カーディアス・ビスト$$'s younger sister. Age 55.
She married into the Carbine family, relatives of Anaheim's chairman, and is a formidable woman whose business acumen surpasses her husband's.
She schemes to preserve the Vist Foundation's prosperity by keeping the secret of 'Laplace's Box' intact, and moved her nephew $$アルベルト$$ to arrange the murder of $$カーディアス$$, who intended to disclose the box.

library.pt_160:r_46a8d03a9b8a9600.text:
$$カーディアス・ビスト$$'s younger sister. Age 55.
She married into the Carbine family, relatives of Anaheim's chairman, and is a formidable woman whose business acumen surpasses her husband's.
She schemes to preserve the Vist Foundation's prosperity by keeping the secret of 'Laplace's Box' intact, and moved her nephew $$アルベルト$$ to arrange the murder of $$カーディアス$$, who intended to disclose the box.
Afterward she continues to scheme to obtain the Unicorn, using her power to set various plots in motion.

library.pt_160:r_6a33f61c5bf4e917.text:
$$カーディアス・ビスト$$'s secretary. Age unknown.
A former Federation soldier, he also serves as a bodyguard.
He was deeply trusted by $$カーディアス$$ and handled the confidential management of the 'UC Project'. After $$カーディアス$$'s death, he watches over how events unfold under Syam Vist, the first head of the Vist Foundation.

library.pt_160:r_64d8b2c65810684a.text:
A member of the Earth Federation Government's Central Assembly. Age 52.
He is $$リディ・マーセナス$$'s father and a descendant of Ricardo Marcenas, the Earth Federation's first prime minister, and wields power as chairman of the Council on Emigration Issues, also known as the shadow cabinet.
He is one of the few people who knows the secret of 'Laplace's Box'.
When $$リディ$$ returns to shelter $$オードリー$$, $$ローナン$$ tells him what the box contains and the truth behind it, revealing the secret of the Marcenas family.

library.pt_160:r_5175245072ced3ac.text:
A pilot of the Imperial Space Force's Team Top.
She hails from the Okinawa Girls' Space High School attached to the Imperial Space Force, commonly known as Oki-jo.
Her father was Admiral Yuzo Takaya, captain of the deep-space survey ship Ruuxion.
She is a bit clumsy and scatterbrained, but has an optimistic personality. Her athletic ability is outstanding, and she has the stamina to run fifty grueling laps of the training ground unassisted, a feat that taxes even powered machinery. Her hobbies are varied, including watching anime and building plastic models.
Through an unconventional selection by her coach (Kouichirou Ota), she is chosen as a candidate pilot for the Third New Robot Project alongside $$カズミ$$, the 'big sister' she admires. From then on she is assigned to the space battleship Exelion, honing her skills alongside $$カズミ$$, Jung, and others.
In the course of the fighting, she faces numerous trials, including conflict over her pairing with $$カズミ$$ and the loss of Smith Toren, for whom she harbored a budding affection. But she overcomes them through the effort and guts the coach taught her, growing into the pilot of the $$ガンバスター$$, Earth's ultimate trump card for defense.
In the final battle against the Space Monsters, she activates a malfunctioning black hole bomb and is swallowed up by its implosion along with $$カズミ$$.

library.pt_160:r_f74c7b35108863e6.text:
A pilot of the Imperial Space Force's Team Top.
Like $$ノリコ$$, she hails from the Okinawa Girls' Space High School attached to the Imperial Space Force, commonly known as Oki-jo. Within the school, every student adores her as an 'onee-sama', and she also carries the nickname 'the Rose Queen'.
She is intelligent and graceful, yet strong-willed, occasionally showing intense emotion as well. Though blessed with natural talent as a pilot, she never grows arrogant about it and remains sincere, never forgetting to put in the effort.
She is selected alongside $$ノリコ$$ as a candidate pilot for the Third New Robot Project, though at first she questions why $$ノリコ$$ was chosen to join her. Even so, she comes to sympathize with $$ノリコ$$'s earnest, never-give-up attitude, and the two deepen their bond as a pair.
She falls for the coach, Kouichirou Ota, and later marries him.
After the coach's death she serves as an instructor at Oki-jo, but in the final battle against the Space Monsters she boards the $$ガンバスター$$ once more alongside $$ノリコ$$. In the final operation, she activates a malfunctioning black hole bomb and is swallowed up by its implosion along with $$ノリコ$$.

library.pt_160:r_949d7076bd60469e.text:
The vocalist and lead guitarist of Fire Bomber.
He is free-spirited and acts purely on emotion, which can make him look self-centered at first glance, but it is all the result of loving song above all else and pouring his entire being into singing. However, that same passion sometimes leads him to say and do things ordinary people simply cannot understand.
When the $$マクロス７$$ fleet made contact with the Protodeviln, he sang on the battlefield to let them hear his song. At first this earned him the anger of those around him, $$ガムリン$$ included, but the number of people who came to understand his passion gradually grew, and in the end his singing brought the war between humanity and the Protodeviln to an end.
After the fighting ended, he achieved tremendous popularity through the Galaxy Network. But he suddenly set off on a carefree solo journey, and on the planet Zola he communed through song with the Galactic Whale, an energy life-form. There he was reunited with $$ガムリン$$ and $$ミレーヌ$$, who had come after him, but $$バサラ$$ left them behind and set out once more on a new journey.
His favorite foods are anything spicy. His hobbies are napping and 'making people listen to my singing'.
Few people besides himself can read the original symbols he writes on the score when composing.

library.pt_160:r_c70ba26c54ff07e3.text:
The vocalist and bassist of Fire Bomber.
She is honest, cheerful, and full of curiosity. At an age where she wants to seem more grown-up, she dislikes being treated like a child, though her thinking is still age-appropriate, and she can be seen acting on emotion and impulse.
Her parents are the genius Max and the ace Milia, and she has considerable skill and nerve as a pilot in her own right.
The free-spirited $$バサラ$$ always leaves her irritated, but she openly acknowledges his singing. She is also interested in him romantically, though she has yet to take the first step. At the same time, she has feelings for $$ガムリン$$, whom she met through an arranged meeting and who proposed to her before the showdown with the Protodeviln, but neither relationship has progressed.
She could not stop thinking about $$バサラ$$, who had left on a journey without saying where he was going, and remained distracted, but with a push from Ray she set off for the planet Zola.

library.pt_160:r_2852ee8f28de3b14.text:
A former U.N. Spacy pilot who now leads Fire Bomber, where he plays keyboard.
He was among the first to recognize $$バサラ$$'s talent and be touched by his passion, and he acts as something of a guardian to him. He is also one of the few people who can read the scores $$バサラ$$ writes.
After sending off $$ミレーヌ$$, who was worried about the traveling $$バサラ$$, to the planet Zola, the band was left without a vocalist, but he pulled off a successful live show through the drastic measure of playing recorded vocals from a boombox in front of cardboard cutouts of $$バサラ$$ and $$ミレーヌ$$.

library.pt_160:r_2307bf69f48823a5.text:
A pure-blooded Zentradi woman who plays drums for Fire Bomber.
She boasts the superhuman strength typical of the Zentradi, along with astonishing eyesight of 7.2.
She is extremely taciturn, and is always tapping something with her drumsticks.
She hides a burning passion within her, and in the showdown with the Protodeviln her drumming helped generate Song Energy.

library.pt_160:r_cdb11f5db699c26f.text:
The captain of Diamond Force, an elite unit of the $$マクロス７$$ fleet. His rank is captain.
Being a serious person to the core, he did not think well of $$バサラ$$ singing on the battlefield when they first met. But through the fighting he was touched by $$バサラ$$'s passion, and he is now one of $$バサラ$$'s best supporters.
Through his interactions with $$バサラ$$ and $$ミレーヌ$$, whom he met through an arranged meeting, his rigid personality softened somewhat, but his hopelessness with women remained unchanged. His relationship with $$ミレーヌ$$, whom he even proposed to before the showdown with the Protodeviln, does not seem to have made any notable progress since.
Worried about $$ミレーヌ$$, who could no longer concentrate on her singing over $$バサラ$$, who had left on a journey without saying where he was going, he headed to the planet Zola to bring him back.

library.pt_160:r_9dd3bd8b9bd5cbb7.text:
A second-year student in the space navigation course at Mihoshi Academy's upper school. 17 years old.
He is beautiful and delicate enough to be mistaken for a woman. His personality seems cool and cynical, but he also has a short temper, flaring up as soon as $$ミシェル$$ calls him by the nickname 'Princess $$アルト$$'.
He was born the eldest son of the Saotome family, a distinguished name in galactic kabuki, and was raised under his strict father's harsh instruction. Blessed with talent, he stood on the kabuki stage from a young age as a child prodigy of the Saotome troupe. But in the course of playing his roles he lost sight of himself, and retired from the world of kabuki. He then chose the path of becoming a pilot as an ordinary student. His dream is to fly through a real sky, not one with a ceiling like the Frontier fleet's.
When the Frontier fleet comes under attack by the Vajra, circumstances lead him to board a VF-25 and fight. He later joins the private military provider $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ (Strategic Military Services), and throws himself into the fight against the Vajra alongside $$ミシェル$$ and the others.

library.pt_160:r_dd81ad0c69bf9931.text:
A pilot of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Skull Squadron. His rank is second lieutenant. 17 years old.
He is normally a second-year student in the space navigation course at Mihoshi Academy. $$アルト$$'s classmate, he knows about $$アルト$$'s past as an onnagata in galactic kabuki and teases him by calling him 'Princess $$アルト$$'. He is basically a caring person, but also has a coldly blunt side, speaking facts directly.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ he pilots a VF-25G. He carries Zola blood, and his superhuman eyesight gives him outstanding marksmanship, which he puts to use as the unit's sniper. That same excellent eyesight is so strong it interferes with daily life, so he normally wears corrective glasses to lower it.
He and $$クラン$$, a childhood friend and fellow $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ member, have feelings for each other, but neither can quite be honest about it.

library.pt_160:r_09087eccde850691.text:
A pilot of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Skull Squadron. His rank is second lieutenant. 17 years old.
He is normally a second-year student in the space navigation course at Mihoshi Academy. $$アルト$$'s classmate, he knows about $$アルト$$'s past as an onnagata in galactic kabuki and teases him by calling him 'Princess $$アルト$$'. He is basically a caring person, but also has a coldly blunt side, speaking facts directly.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ he pilots a VF-25G. He fights as a sniper, making the most of his outstanding marksmanship. This is because he carries Zola blood and has superhuman eyesight. But that same excellent eyesight is so strong it interferes with daily life, so he normally wears corrective glasses to lower it.
He and $$クラン$$, a childhood friend and fellow $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ member, have feelings for each other.

library.pt_160:r_460ea882ef563b72.text:
A member of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Skull Squadron. His rank is warrant officer. 15 years old.
He normally attends Mihoshi Academy, a year below $$アルト$$ and $$ミシェル$$.
He has a gentle personality and serves as a buffer between the often-clashing $$アルト$$ and $$ミシェル$$. His family runs the high-tech company L.A.I., and he is both its heir and a technical advisor, well-versed in mecha and electronics.
When he sorties he pilots an RVF-25, handling advanced electronic warfare and remote combat.
He also has an older sister named Julia.

library.pt_160:r_b08ba398b8070bc4.text:
The captain of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Skull Squadron. His rank is major. 27 years old.
His personality matches his rugged looks: hair carelessly tied back and stubble on his chin. He is a commander excellent in both insight and judgment, and also understands the subtleties of human feeling.
Before joining $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ he was an ace pilot of the New U.N. Spacy, and he pilots the state-of-the-art VF-25 with his exceptional flying skill. He is the pillar of Skull Squadron, both technically and spiritually.
Eleven years ago, after failing to save $$ランカ$$'s family from a Vajra attack, he took in the orphaned $$ランカ$$ and raised her as her older brother.

library.pt_160:r_eaf1e6b0e84d210f.text:
The captain of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Pixie Squadron. Her rank is captain. 18 years old.
A pilot who carries on Zentradi pride. In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ she commands Pixie Squadron, a unit made up entirely of Zentradi women, piloting a crimson $$クァドラン・レア$$ and displaying valiant, fearless combat skill.
At giant size she has an outstanding figure befitting her age, but when micronized her body reverts to that of a young girl.
She is a childhood friend of $$ミシェル$$'s and a year ahead of him at Mihoshi Academy. She is always concerned about him, whether on the battlefield or in private.

library.pt_160:r_e8e5471f4523a4c1.text:
The captain of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Pixie Squadron. Her rank is captain. 18 years old.
She normally spends her days micronized as a third-year student at Mihoshi Academy. Though a senior to $$アルト$$ and the others, she also has a childish, innocent side, such as stealing the char siu off the galactic ramen $$ミシェル$$ ordered.
When she sorties as a member of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, she reverts to giant size and boards her $$クァドラン・レア$$.

library.pt_160:r_2eae668e217daf3c.text:
A pilot of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Skull Squadron. Her rank is first lieutenant.
She holds a medical license and also serves as a combat medic in peacetime. She is normally quiet and speaks little, but shows the consideration of a mature woman.
When she sorties she pilots the heavy variable bomber VB-6 Koenig Monster, taking down enemies with bold attacks.

library.pt_160:r_d98c13842cf2fc22.text:
A pilot of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Skull Squadron. Her rank is first lieutenant.
She holds a medical license and also serves as a combat medic in peacetime. She is normally quiet and speaks little, but shows the consideration of a mature woman.
When she sorties she pilots the heavy variable bomber VB-6 Koenig Monster, taking down enemies with bold attacks.
She is also the one who tells $$アルト$$ that $$ランカ$$ suffers from 'dissociative amnesia'.

library.pt_160:r_23ef926cdb2f9838.text:
The captain of the Macross Quarter, $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$'s flagship. His rank is colonel.
A battle-hardened veteran with a large old scar on his face. He was once a pilot himself, with experience flying generations of the U.N. Spacy's mainline fighters. With his composed manner, occasional flashes of humor, and the presence he exudes, he is fully trusted by every member of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ He also has a bold streak, committing to daring tactics when it counts.
His hobby is surfing.

library.pt_160:r_0ec34f5ea4e8188f.text:
The helmsman of the Macross Quarter. His rank is captain.
He normally speaks in a feminine manner and enjoys chatting with the female crew. But once battle begins and he grips the control stick, a completely different, hot-blooded, masculine side of him comes out.
With his superb ship-handling skill, he maneuvers the Macross Quarter with precision and daring.

library.pt_160:r_fcc137c1ae5a93d8.text:
An officer of the New U.N. Spacy general staff. Her rank is first lieutenant. 23 years old.
A woman of both beauty and brains, with a sharp mind and looks that once earned her runner-up in the Miss Macross Frontier pageant. She is also the daughter of Frontier's President Howard Glass.
She joins $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ on assignment from the New U.N. Spacy and serves as a bridge operator.
She and $$オズマ$$ were once lovers, and she still harbors lingering feelings for him.

library.pt_160:r_0829813a3e973203.text:
An operator aboard the Macross Quarter.
She serves as the radar operator in charge of enemy detection.
She has a serious, class-president type personality, and acts as the leader who keeps $$ラム$$ and $$ミーナ#182$$ in line.
She secretly harbors feelings for Captain $$ジェフリー$$.

library.pt_160:r_f27de58d9daa7787.text:
An operator aboard the Macross Quarter.
She is in charge of monitoring the ship's internal status.
She has a laid-back, hard-to-read personality, but is actually a genius with an IQ of 180.

library.pt_160:r_c07282f597f8124d.text:
An operator aboard the Macross Quarter.
She handles communications and weapons control.
She loves data more than anything, and excels at gathering and analyzing it. She also has a somewhat sharp tongue.

library.pt_160:r_4cb1db7f6468fd3e.text:
A first-year student at Saint Maria Academy. 15 years old.
A girl who loves to sing. While attending the prestigious girls' school, she also works part-time at the Chinese restaurant 'Nyan Nyan'. She has a bright, innocent personality and works hard, but she is also reserved and lacks confidence in herself.
She lives with her older brother $$オズマ$$, though they are not related by blood. Because of dissociative amnesia she remembers nothing of her past, and the only thing that remains in her memory is a song called 'Aimo'. She also reacts excessively when someone close to her is injured, a result of the shock in her past.
A huge fan of $$シェリル$$, she dreams of becoming a singer, and with a push from $$アルト$$ she begins walking the path toward her long-held dream.
When the Vajra attack the Frontier fleet, she draws attention by singing alongside $$シェリル$$, and begins climbing the road to becoming a top idol.

library.pt_160:r_0bc5e4299167dc87.text:
A wildly popular artist from the Macross Galaxy fleet.
Known for her voice and beauty as 'the Galactic Fairy', she consistently ranks near the top of the galactic hit charts. She has a lively, competitive personality and cannot help but act the moment she makes up her mind. She can be proud and lacking in cooperation, but she also possesses an unfailing drive for self-improvement and a strong professional consciousness.
She has never had any cosmetic surgery or mechanical implants done to her body, which is also part of her popularity.
She visits Macross Frontier as the final stop of her galaxy-spanning tour and holds a live concert there, where she meets $$アルト$$ and $$ランカ$$.

library.pt_160:r_cbf706cc3d2baa25.text:
Chief secretary to the President of Macross Frontier's New United Government. 26 years old.
Also a staff officer of the New U.N. Spacy, he is responsible for countermeasures against the Vajra. Intelligent and highly capable, his skills have earned him the trust of President Howard, who relies heavily on him.
He conducts research and analysis on the Vajra, taking note of their hidden power.

library.pt_160:r_c125736b292b842e.text:
The president of a talent agency.
A Zentradi, he runs the small talent agency 'Vector Promotions'. Upon hearing $$ランカ$$ sing, he calls her 'the fated diva I've been searching for' and scouts her.

library.pt_160:r_9e17da3437ca0496.text:
A kabuki actor of the Saotome school. $$アルト$$'s senior fellow disciple.
Distinguished by his narrow eyes, he always wears a gentle smile.

library.pt_160:r_ce82906da2b150ff.text:
The leader of the Getter Team.
He is short-tempered, impulsive, and combative, calling Professor Saotome 'old geezer' and generally foul-mouthed. Though a man of many problems, he is a martial artist of exceptional physical and mental strength, and an unmatched talent as a Getter Robo pilot.
In the Ruunar War he piloted Getter-1 and stood at the head of the Super Robot Corps. His ferocious fighting spirit contributed to the annihilation of the Invaders, making him a heroic figure at the time.
He was later imprisoned as the man who killed Professor Saotome, but when the professor reappeared alongside the Invaders, he was granted parole on the condition that he assassinate the professor.
At that time, he worked together with his former comrades $$隼人$$ and Musashi, as well as the mysterious man $$號$$, to corner the professor, but they were unable to stop the deuterium missile launched at Japan, and the world was destroyed.
$$竜馬$$ then went missing for thirteen years.
He awoke in the cockpit of a Getter Robo that had been abandoned on the moon across time and space, repaired the Getter Robo with his own hands, and returned to Earth. He fought the Invaders in the Getter, its body turned black from the heat of atmospheric friction.
After Shin Dragon awakened and $$號$$ left the front lines, he boarded Shin Getter together with $$隼人$$ and $$弁慶$$.
After settling things with Professor Saotome, he went up into space and fought a desperate battle against the Invaders, who sought to seize the entire galaxy.
In the end, he threw himself into a battle in the gap of time that continues for all eternity, and departed for another dimension.

library.pt_160:r_cd8c4808037f4a9f.text:
A former member of the Getter Team.
He becomes the commander of the Tower, searching for Shin Dragon in an effort to prevent the world's last day from coming, and fighting to dismantle its core.
In addition to his calm, composed personality, he has the strength to be utterly ruthless when carrying out his mission, a trait born of his unshakeable will.
After launching a suicide attack from the Tower to stop Shin Dragon's awakening, he boards Shin Getter together with $$竜馬$$ and $$弁慶$$. Despite his first time back in a Getter in a long while, he displays the same outstanding teamwork as before.
After settling things with Professor Saotome, he goes up into space and fights a desperate battle against the Invaders, who seek to seize the entire galaxy.
In the end, he throws himself into a battle in the gap of time that continues for all eternity, and departs for another dimension.

library.pt_160:r_459dcc0ad29cef6c.text:
A reserve member of the former Getter Team.
When the deuterium missile was dropped on Japan, he fled to an underground shelter together with Genki, and raised her as Kei.
Thirteen years later, while exploring the surface, he encounters the battle between the Tower and the Invaders. He boards Shin Getter once to escape the crisis, but withdraws from the front lines afterward due to his injuries.
After Shin Dragon awakens and $$號$$ leaves the front lines, he boards Shin Getter together with $$竜馬$$ and $$隼人$$.
After settling things with Professor Saotome, he goes up into space and fights a desperate battle against the Invaders, who seek to seize the entire galaxy.
In the end, he throws himself into a battle in the gap of time that continues for all eternity, and departs for another dimension.

library.pt_160:r_64e3ef463bfd6473.text:
A new type of human born from the fusion of Professor Saotome's and Michiru Saotome's cells, exposed to Getter rays. He was created to become the pilot of Shin Dragon, but the plan itself ended in failure.
He was missing for thirteen years, but reappears unchanged in order to save Kei. He rides Shin Getter, fighting primarily to protect her.
He was taciturn and rarely showed emotion outside of combat, but through the fighting he came to connect with Kei and the others, gradually showing more human feeling.
In the final battle he pilots $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ and fights alongside $$竜馬$$ and the rest of the Getter Team. In the end, he sends off $$竜馬$$ and the others as they depart for a battle that continues for all eternity.

library.pt_160:r_8fdf15b6aa345119.text:
Professor Saotome's daughter, Genki Saotome.
$$弁慶$$, who fled to an underground shelter from the deuterium missile's explosion, changed the name of Genki, the child of the man who had destroyed the world, to Kei, and raised her as his own daughter. Kei lived without any memory of her time as Genki.
Taking after her adoptive father, she has an impulsive, straightforward personality, and is more tomboy than not.
While exploring the surface, contaminated by Getter rays, together with $$弁慶$$ and the others, she encounters the battle between the Tower and the Invaders. Rescued by $$號$$ from the crisis, she boards Shin Getter, and from then on serves as the pilot of $$真ゲッター２$$.
After Professor Saotome's revival she regains her lost memories, and from then on continues to pursue the whereabouts of the vanished Shin Dragon in order to settle things.
Once the fighting moves into space, she remains on Earth with $$凱$$ and the now-deceased $$號$$, but with the cooperation of the Japanese government, she goes up into space. There she is rescued by the revived $$號$$, piloting $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, and boards it.
She fights alongside $$竜馬$$ and the rest of the Getter Team, and in the end sends off $$竜馬$$ and the others as they depart for a battle that continues for all eternity.

library.pt_160:r_462b04f816ded0d3.text:
A young man exploring the surface, contaminated by Getter rays, together with $$弁慶$$ and Kei.
He inherited the skill of his father, once a renowned Getter Robo mechanic, and is skilled with machinery.
He has a gentle personality that dislikes conflict, but also has a side to him that becomes unstoppable once he snaps.
While exploring the surface he encounters the battle between the Tower and the Invaders. He is named by $$號$$ to pilot Shin Bear in place of the injured $$弁慶$$.
Though inexperienced, he fights hard and gradually builds up teamwork, but when $$號$$ is rendered unable to fight, he hands Shin Getter over to $$竜馬$$ and the others.
Once the fighting moves into space he remains on Earth, but with the cooperation of the Japanese government he goes up into space together with Kei. There he is rescued by the revived $$號$$, piloting $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, and boards it.
He fights alongside $$竜馬$$ and the rest of the Getter Team, and in the end sends off $$竜馬$$ and the others as they depart for a battle that continues for all eternity.

library.pt_160:r_adbf6c3770573ef6.text:
The pilot of $$マジンガーＺ$$.
An ordinary high school student aiming to become a motorcycle racer, he was entrusted with the Hover Pilder and $$マジンガーＺ$$ by his grandfather Juuzou, and fought against Dr. Hell.
He has a bright, easygoing temperament and is good at cooking. But he is also considerably tough with his fists, and is rumored in some circles to be the shadow boss of Atami.
He is also extremely devoted to his family, treasuring his younger brother $$シロー$$ and revering his grandfather Juuzou. He flies into a rage and becomes unstoppable if he hears anyone speak ill of his grandfather.
After meeting $$錦織つばさ$$, he comes to make his home at $$くろがね屋$$.
At first he relied entirely on $$マジンガーＺ$$'s power and fought in a self-centered way. But through special training at $$くろがね屋$$ and fighting alongside $$さやか$$ and the Mazinger Corps, he grows both as a person and as a pilot.
When he fights Danube Alpha 1, he learns that $$つばさ$$ is his mother, and that she killed his father Kenzou, and he leaves $$くろがね屋$$ together with $$シロー$$. library.pt_160:r_5c762df2c0e618ac.text:
The pilot of $$マジンガーＺ$$.
An ordinary high school student aiming to become a motorcycle racer, he was entrusted with the Hover Pilder and $$マジンガーＺ$$ by his grandfather Juuzou, and fought against Dr. Hell.
He has a bright, easygoing temperament and is good at cooking. But he is also considerably tough with his fists, and is rumored in some circles to be the shadow boss of Atami.
He is also extremely devoted to his family, treasuring his younger brother $$シロー$$ and revering his grandfather Juuzou. He flies into a rage and becomes unstoppable if he hears anyone speak ill of his grandfather.
After meeting $$錦織つばさ$$, he comes to make his home at $$くろがね屋$$.

He then takes shelter at the Photonic Power Laboratory and keeps his distance from $$つばさ$$, but when he fights Kedora he catches a glimpse of $$つばさ$$'s past and learns the truth of the matter, finally reconciling with her.
In the final battle, he swears to defeat Dr. Hell and joins hands with his old enemy $$あしゅら男爵$$.
He defeats Dr. Hell, but can only stand frozen in shock at the unforeseen, worst-case turn of events that follows.

library.pt_160:r_46d4b71dee5dc8d4.text:
The pilot of Aphrodite A and its successor unit, $$ビューナスＡ$$.
The daughter of $$弓弥之助$$, director of the Photonic Power Laboratory, she is serious and values cooperation.
She has also shown devotion by risking herself to stop $$甲児$$, who over-relies on Mazinger's power and tries to fight alone.
She and $$甲児$$ are interested in each other, but since both are hopeless when it comes to romance, their relationship remains stuck at more-than-friends, less-than-lovers.
After Aphrodite A is destroyed, she asks the Three Professors to build $$ビューナスＡ$$ modeled after herself. In the final battle, with $$甲児$$ absent, she fights hard to intercept Dr. Hell's forces.

library.pt_160:r_32af2e2b0f50b965.text:
A delinquent leader who aims to conquer Japan's students, uniting Japan's alliance of delinquent gang bosses.
Commanding delinquent bosses from across Japan, he marches into Atami, the last holdout. He challenges $$甲児$$, believed to be the local shadow boss, but is defeated, and in the midst of it runs into an attack by $$あしゅら$$'s forces.
Afterward he lodges at $$くろがね屋$$, but is held to account over unpaid lodging fees, and ends up gradually drawn into the fight against Dr. Hell.
In the final battle, he plays a huge part, scolding a troubled $$甲児$$ and taking on the Mechanical Beasts in $$ボスボロット$$, a converted work robot.
It is said that even the author does not know his real name.

library.pt_160:r_dd0f079d1dda3e41.text:
One of $$ボス$$'s henchmen.
Despite his vacant expression and runny nose, which give no hint of it, he is a master of drunken fist boxing with championship-level skill in Japan.
When he made quick work of Iron Mask with that skill, together with $$ムチャ$$, $$甲児$$ remarked that 'he might be stronger than $$ボス$$'.

library.pt_160:r_1bf514e5dd9054ef.text:
One of $$ボス$$'s henchmen.
His small stature and obedience to $$ボス$$ make him look like nothing more than a hanger-on at first glance, but he is actually a master at flicking firecracker pellets with pinpoint speed. He once nailed Iron Mask square in the face with a firecracker pellet faster than the man could level his gun, proof that his skill is the real thing.
